         <quote><lg> <l>kha <lb edRef="inst:5293" n="33b7"/> gcig rnam pa lnga yis smra | </l><l>mngon sum dang ni mi dmigs pa'i ||</l>

          <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:7785">khong</rs> gis mdzad pa'i <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7786">rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dngos po grub po</rs> las ||
         <quote><lg><l>gal te snga ma'i mi dmigs pas  ||</l>

         <l>gcod pa med na de ci zhig</l>
         <l>gcad de na phyi mas ci zhig <lb edRef="inst:5293" n="34a1"/> bya</l></lg></quote> zhes bshad de | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3892">chos rje sa skya pa</rs> yang de'i lugs dang mthun par phrugs gsum du bzhed do ||</seg></TEI>
